prompt: Take an upcoming assignment. List its parts and mark each one keep, delegate or get feedback, with one reason for each.

criteria.label: Marks each part
criteria.look_for: each part labelled keep, delegate or get feedback

criteria.label: Gives reasons tied to learning
criteria.look_for: reasons that protect the skill the assignment builds

reference: Research essay: thesis and argument: keep, because forming the argument is the skill being graded. Finding sources: keep, but ask AI for search terms. Reference list formatting: delegate, I can check it against the style guide. Draft paragraphs: get feedback on clarity after I write them myself.
